newsitem.title: USA: US PLAINS FED CATTLE BID $63-$64, PASSED -FEEDLOTS.
newsitem.headline: US PLAINS FED CATTLE BID $63-$64, PASSED -FEEDLOTS.

text.p: U.S. Plains fed cattle early Monday were bid $63.00 to $64.00 in light activity and passed by owners pricing cattle mostly at $65.00, with a few at $66.00, feedlot sources said.
Sales last week bottomed at $64.00, down $2.00 from the previous week's top.
Fed cattle prices this week could be pressured by carryover of a large number of cattle from last week's showlists, the sources said.
Losses also could be spurred by weak beef prices last week, although lower prices encouraged brisk sales, they said.
